problems.quote: through accredited entities such as NABARD, SIDBI, and the Indian Renewable Energy Development Agency (IREDA).
problems.problem: SIDBI and IREDA are accredited to the Green Climate Fund but not to the Adaptation Fund; only NABARD is accredited to both.
problems.correction: through accredited entities such as NABARD for both funds, and SIDBI, IREDA for GCF only.
problems.verifierReason: SIDBI and IREDA are GCF-accredited only; NABARD is accredited to both GCF and Adaptation Fund. Correction is precise.

problems.quote: The “Loss and Damage” fund agreed at COP27 remains operationalised through a transitional committee
problems.problem: By COP28 (December 2023) the Loss and Damage fund had been operationalised; the transitional committee had completed its mandate.
problems.correction: The “Loss and Damage” fund agreed at COP27 was operationalised at COP28.
problems.verifierReason: Loss and Damage Fund was operationalized at COP28 (Nov 2023); Transitional Committee mandate ended then. Original quote outdated.
